say:0:1720783001:1.text: As a somber yet soulful song drifts from the stage, silence settles over the hall.
say:0:1720783001:1.source_cn: 随着一阵苍凉而深情的琴声响起，宴会厅的一角渐渐安静了下来。

say:2:1720783002:0.text: "... Born before April's end, his blue eyes reflected the scenery of his homeland..."
say:2:1720783002:0.source_cn: “……他生在四月末尾，湛蓝的眼睛，映照着故乡的风景……”

say:3:1720783003:0.text: "... Fallen before the dawn, his fractured sword reborn as a star shining on..."
say:3:1720783003:0.source_cn: “……他倒在黎明之前，手中的断剑，化作了永恒的晨星……”

say:4:1720783004:0.text: Both nobles and servants alike pause in their tracks, entranced by the minstrel's voice.
say:4:1720783004:0.source_cn: 无论是端着酒杯的贵族，还是忙碌的侍从，都停下了动作，被...

say:6:1720783005:0.text: Amid the crowd, an elderly woman listens in silence, tears welling in her eyes as the sorrowful song unfolds.
say:6:1720783005:0.source_cn: 人群中，一位老妇人眼含热泪，静静地聆听着这如泣如诉的歌声。

say:8:1720783006:0.text: Your Highness, thank you for inviting me here. I told the minstrel Julino's story, and he wrote this song for me...
say:8:1720783006:0.source_cn: 殿下，感谢您让我来到这里。我只是向那位吟游诗人讲了朱利...

say:9:1720783007:0.text: His voice... is so full of emotion. I feel as though Julino is right here, telling me he didn't die for nothing.
say:9:1720783007:0.source_cn: 这歌声……真好。好像朱利诺正在我耳边说话，告诉我……他...

say:10:1720783008:0.text: Of course, he didn't. Just look around—we wouldn't be able to enjoy this banquet tonight if not for his sacrifice.
say:10:1720783008:0.source_cn: 他当然没有白白牺牲。您看，这满堂的灯火，人们脸上的笑容...

say:11:1720783009:1.text: This song shall stand as a remembrance of everything Julino has done for Savannah.
say:11:1720783009:1.source_cn: 从今往后，每当这首歌在赛凡纳响起，人们就会记起他的名字...

say:12:1720783010:1.text: I am... deeply grateful, Your Highness. This is the best gift I could have as his mother...
say:12:1720783010:1.source_cn: 谢谢……谢谢您，殿下。作为一个母亲，这是我能收到的……...
